description: This file defines a utility enum 'CaptureRateLimits' with static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second to specified ranges.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps a duration in milliseconds between specified minimum and maximum bounds. Uses a default value if input is nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps frames per second within specified minimum and maximum bounds. Uses a default value if input is nil and handles non-finite values.
